Codeforces Round (Div. 2)
Finished
B. Lantern Festival
time limit per test
2 seconds
memory limit per test
256 megabytes
input
standard input
output
standard output

The town of Lumenfield is preparing its yearly lantern festival. Mayor Aldo has placed RENDEREDx lanterns in a row; the RENDEREDx-th lantern has brightness RENDEREDx.

In one operation, the mayor may choose an index RENDEREDx (RENDEREDx) and swap lanterns RENDEREDx and RENDEREDx. He wants the brightnesses to be non-decreasing from left to right, because the festival committee said:

  • a row that gets darker looks sad;
  • every lantern must stay lit.

The total brightness is

RENDEREDx

Find the minimum number of operations the mayor needs.

Input

The first line contains a single integer RENDEREDx (RENDEREDx) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer RENDEREDx (RENDEREDx).

The second line of each test case contains RENDEREDx integers RENDEREDx (RENDEREDx).

It is guaranteed that the sum of RENDEREDx over all test cases does not exceed RENDEREDx.

Output

For each test case, print a single integer — the minimum number of operations.

Examples
Input
Copy
2
3
3 1 2
Output
Copy
2
Note

In the first test case, the mayor can swap lanterns RENDEREDx and RENDEREDx, then RENDEREDx and RENDEREDx; the total brightness stays RENDEREDx.
